stages.label: Datapath + base memory
stages.scope: WO23 source-checked custom configuration: joint datapath, existing N16 mappings, resident arenas, original routing and KV policy. This grouped transition from Baseline 2 is not an isolated hardware or memory ablation.

stages.label: Hardware refinement
stages.scope: WO24 hardware with the old software policy; all earlier capabilities retained.

stages.label: Producer-layout fusion
stages.scope: Enable rounded attention producer-layout storage fusion; no cross-wave prefetch or second accumulator.

stages.label: Cross-wave prefetch
stages.scope: Enable paid cross-wave prefetch while retaining producer fusion and one FP32 accumulator context.

stages.label: Double-buffered accumulators
stages.scope: Add the second FP32 context with fusion and prefetch retained. Original output conversion, stores and reduction order remain paid.

stages.label: Hardware + KV retention
stages.scope: Current chip and original source policy, with all original KV owners, first imports, stores, full-K arithmetic, mapping workspace and delivery costs. The initial transition groups hardware, base tiling and KV retention; these are not separately attributed.

stages.label: Tiling extension
stages.scope: Extend 25 to 31 compatible logical mappings, with weight retention still disabled and unchanged KV policy.

stages.label: Attention-weight residency
stages.scope: Enable only this additional class of the original independent weight selectors. All prior retained classes stay on; first loads and every kernel weight read remain charged.

stages.label: MLP-weight residency
stages.scope: Enable only this additional class of the original independent weight selectors. All prior retained classes stay on; first loads and every kernel weight read remain charged.

stages.label: Output-weight residency
stages.scope: Enable only this additional class of the original independent weight selectors. All prior retained classes stay on; first loads and every kernel weight read remain charged.

stages.label: Hardware + KV retention
stages.scope: Current chip and original source policy, with all original KV owners, first imports, stores, full-K arithmetic, mapping workspace and delivery costs. The initial transition groups hardware, base tiling and KV retention; these are not separately attributed.

stages.label: Tiling extension
stages.scope: Extend 14 to 25 compatible logical mappings, with weight retention still disabled and unchanged KV policy.

stages.label: Attention-weight residency
stages.scope: Enable only this additional class of the original independent weight selectors. All prior retained classes stay on; first loads and every kernel weight read remain charged.

stages.label: MLP-weight residency
stages.scope: Enable only this additional class of the original independent weight selectors. All prior retained classes stay on; first loads and every kernel weight read remain charged.

stages.label: Output-weight residency
stages.scope: Enable only this additional class of the original independent weight selectors. All prior retained classes stay on; first loads and every kernel weight read remain charged.

stages.label: Hardware + KV retention
stages.scope: Current chip and original source policy, with all original KV owners, first imports, stores, full-K arithmetic, mapping workspace and delivery costs. The initial transition groups hardware, base tiling and KV retention; these are not separately attributed.

stages.label: Tiling extension
stages.scope: Extend 14 to 25 compatible mappings, with independent attention heads and weight retention still disabled.

stages.label: KV-head reuse (GQA)
stages.scope: Enable the original group-eight attention implementation on the same chip and 25-mapping menu. This is KV-read reuse, distinct from retention.

stages.label: Attention-weight residency
stages.scope: Retain attention weights, with GQA and all preceding features enabled. Initial loads and kernel reads remain paid.

stages.label: MLP/output-weight residency
stages.scope: Retain the remaining original MLP and output-head weights. All original initial imports and kernel reads remain charged.

llama1_13b.capacity_argument: Every stage retains a subset of the final selected whole-weight owners. It cannot exceed the original all-retained live inventory. Transient imports use the already reserved staging path. Mapping minima check bank compatibility; original KV, activation and output obligations stay fixed.
llama1_13b.independence_argument: Original descriptor import counts and service depend only on descriptor identity and hardware. Mapping and GQA alter kernel costs; each kernel B read remains paid. Exact extra imports can therefore be added to every selected mapping policy without a new overlap assumption.

method: S_i = original Baseline 2 time / cumulative stage time; S_0 = 1. Slice i = (S_i-S_(i-1))/(S_final-1). Exact signed time savings are also retained. No standalone feature speedup factors or leave-one-out penalties are added.
order_scope: Fixed declared order; interactions are assigned to the later enabling stage. A stage may reselect compatible mappings within the enlarged menu. This is an ordered analytical attribution, not a unique causal partition.
first_stage_scope: Joint custom datapath, base mapping and memory policies. No counterfactual TPU-v3 feature implementation or modified reference is inferred.
source_scope: Fresh exact finite-menu and descriptor cost controls using inherited source contracts. Not new OCS search, full-model execution, lifetime admission or physical sign-off.
